sentences.en: So, this is the case that was brought by the Manhattan District Attorney.
sentences.zh: 这是由曼哈顿地区检察官提起的诉讼。

sentences.en: So, prosecutors have accused Donald Trump of covering up the actions of his former fixer,
sentences.zh: 检察官指控唐纳德·特朗普掩盖其前“清理人”迈克尔·科恩的行为。

sentences.en: Michael Cohen, after Cohen paid hush money to Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 在科恩向斯托米·丹尼尔斯支付封口费之后。

sentences.en: Stormy Daniels had a story about having had sex with Donald Trump, which Trump has always denied.
sentences.zh: 斯托米·丹尼尔斯曾声称与唐纳德·特朗普发生过性关系，特朗普一直予以否认。

sentences.en: Cohen paid her money.
sentences.zh: 科恩付了钱。

sentences.en: And then Trump reimbursed Cohen.
sentences.zh: 然后特朗普偿还了科恩。

sentences.en: And prosecutors say that Trump essentially defrauded the American people because he hid this information that could have been very important for the election from those people when he reimbursed Cohen.
sentences.zh: 检察官称，特朗普在偿还科恩时隐瞒了这些对选举可能非常重要的信息，本质上是欺骗了美国人民。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And as I remember it, he also misrepresented what that reimbursement was, claimed it was a legal fee, when in fact it was just reimbursing Michael Cohen for a hush money payment.
sentences.zh: 据我记忆，他还歪曲了那笔报销的性质，声称那是法律费用，而实际上只是偿还迈克尔·科恩的封口费。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: He definitely didn't say reimbursement for hush money payment to Stormy Daniels.
sentences.zh: 他绝对没有说是偿还给斯托米·丹尼尔斯的封口费。

sentences.en: It's a cover-up case.
sentences.zh: 这是一起掩盖真相的案件。

sentences.en: It's a case about hiding information you don't want people to see.
sentences.zh: 这是一个关于隐瞒你不想让人看到的信息的案件。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And of course, the context of all this is that it is in the middle of a presidential election.
sentences.zh: 当然，这一切的背景是它正处于总统大选期间。

sentences.en: And it's 2016, Trump wants to keep this secret, prosecutors allege, so that the American public doesn't know about it and potentially hold it against him.
sentences.zh: 那是2016年，检察官指控特朗普想保守这个秘密，这样美国公众就不会知道，也就不会因此对他产生负面看法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And prosecutors are telling a story about election interference.
sentences.zh: 检察官讲述的是一个关于选举干预的故事。

sentences.en: They're saying that Trump interfered with an election.
sentences.zh: 他们说特朗普干预了选举。

sentences.en: And Trump himself is also using the phrase election interference.
sentences.zh: 而特朗普本人也在使用“选举干预”这个词。

sentences.en: But he's painting the trial itself as election interference as he now runs again in 2024.
sentences.zh: 但他将审判本身描述为选举干预，因为他现在正在参加2024年的竞选。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太引人入胜了。

sentences.en: And because we're in Manhattan, and because the jury pool is going to be largely Democratic, and the judge is a Democrat, and the district attorney is a Democrat,
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们在曼哈顿，因为陪审团成员大多是民主党人，法官是民主党人，地区检察官也是民主党人，

sentences.en: Trump keeps claiming he cannot get a fair shake.
sentences.zh: 特朗普一直声称他无法得到公正的对待。

sentences.en: This is Democrat Central, and in Democrat Central, Trump doesn't have a chance.
sentences.zh: 这里是民主党的大本营，在民主党的大本营，特朗普没有机会。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So, what happens once you actually enter the courthouse?
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦你真正进入法院会发生什么？

sentences.en: Outside, there's all this fanfare.
sentences.zh: 外面有各种喧嚣。

sentences.en: But inside, it's a little bit business as usual.
sentences.zh: 但在里面，一切照旧。

sentences.en: So, I go up to the 15th floor, and I walk into the courtroom, and I sit down, and it's the same old courtroom, and we're sitting and waiting for the former president.
sentences.zh: 我上到15楼，走进法庭，坐下来，还是那个老样子，我们坐着等待前总统。

sentences.en: Around 9.30, Trump walks in.
sentences.zh: 9点半左右，特朗普走了进来。

sentences.en: He looks thin.
sentences.zh: 他看起来很瘦。

sentences.en: He looks a little tired, kind of slumping forward, as if to say with his body, like, let's get this over with.
sentences.zh: 他看起来有点累，身体前倾，仿佛在用肢体语言说，让我们快点结束吧。

sentences.en: Here we go.
sentences.zh: 开始了。

sentences.en: So, the judge walks in a little bit after that, and we think we're all set for the trial to start.
sentences.zh: 之后法官走了进来，我们以为审判要开始了。

sentences.en: But that's not what happens here.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: And in fact, there are a series of legal arguments about what the trial is going to look like, and what evidence is going to be allowed in.
sentences.zh: 实际上，关于审判的形式以及允许哪些证据进入，进行了一系列法律辩论。

sentences.en: So, for example, prosecutors ask that they be allowed to admit into evidence headlines from the National Enquirer that were attacks on Trump's 2016 opponents, on Ted Cruz,
sentences.zh: 例如，检察官要求允许将《国家询问报》的头条新闻作为证据，这些头条是针对特朗普2016年竞争对手的攻击，针对泰德·克鲁兹、

sentences.en: on Marco Rubio, on Ben Carson.
sentences.zh: 马可·卢比奥、本·卡森。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because prosecutors are, in some sense, putting Trump's 2016 campaign on trial.
sentences.zh: 因为检察官在某种意义上是在审判特朗普的2016年竞选活动。

sentences.en: These headlines are a big part of that, because what prosecutors say they show is that Trump had this ongoing deal with the National Enquirer, and the publisher would promote him,
sentences.zh: 这些头条新闻是其中的重要部分，因为检察官说它们表明特朗普与《国家询问报》达成了持续的协议，出版商会宣传他，

sentences.en: and it would publish damaging stories about his opponents.
sentences.zh: 并发布关于他对手的负面报道。

sentences.en: And then, crucially, it would protect Trump from negative stories.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，它还会保护特朗普免受负面报道的影响。

sentences.en: And that's exactly what prosecutors say happened with Stormy Daniels,
sentences.zh: 而这正是检察官所说的发生在斯托米·丹尼尔斯身上的事情，

sentences.en: that the National Enquirer tipped Cohen off about Stormy Daniels trying to sell her story of having had sex with Donald Trump, which he denies.
sentences.zh: 《国家询问报》向科恩通风报信，说斯托米·丹尼尔斯试图出售她与唐纳德·特朗普发生性关系的故事，而特朗普对此予以否认。

sentences.en: And that led to the hush money payment to her.
sentences.zh: 这导致了给她的封口费。

sentences.en: So, what prosecutors are doing overall with these headlines is establishing a pattern of conduct.
sentences.zh: 所以，检察官利用这些头条新闻总体上是在确立一种行为模式。

sentences.en: And that conduct, they say, was an attempt to influence the election in Trump's favor.
sentences.zh: 他们说，这种行为是试图影响选举以利于特朗普。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And the judge agrees he's going to admit this evidence.
sentences.zh: 法官同意采纳这些证据。

sentences.en: And this is a pretty big win for the prosecution.
sentences.zh: 这对检方来说是一个相当大的胜利。

sentences.en: But even though they win that one, they're not winning everything.
sentences.zh: 但尽管他们赢了这一场，他们并没有赢得一切。

sentences.en: They lose some important arguments here.
sentences.zh: 他们在这里输掉了一些重要的辩论。

sentences.en: One of them was that after the Access Hollywood tape came out, there were allegations of sexual assault against Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，在《好莱坞访问》录音带曝光后，出现了针对唐纳德·特朗普的性侵指控。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you know this, Michael, because you reported two of them, two of the three in question at this very trial.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，你知道这一点，因为你报道过其中的两个，就是这次审判中涉及的三个指控中的两个。

sentences.en: Prosecutors had hoped to talk about those during trial in front of the jury to show the jurors that the Trump campaign was really,
sentences.zh: 检察官曾希望在审判期间当着陪审团的面谈论这些，以向陪审员展示特朗普竞选团队确实，

sentences.en: really focused on pushing back against bad press in the wake of the Access Hollywood tape in which Trump seemed to describe sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 确实专注于在《好莱坞访问》录音带曝光后反击负面新闻，录音带中特朗普似乎描述了性侵行为。

sentences.en: That was a big problem for the campaign.
sentences.zh: 这对竞选团队来说是个大问题。

sentences.en: The campaign did everything it could to push back, including against these allegations that surfaced in the wake of the tape.
sentences.zh: 竞选团队竭尽全力进行反击，包括针对录音带曝光后出现的这些指控。

sentences.en: But the judge, saying that the allegations are hearsay, that they're based on the women's stories, says absolutely not.
sentences.zh: 但法官认为这些指控是传闻，是基于女性的叙述，因此断然拒绝。

sentences.en: That is incredibly prejudicial to the defendant.
sentences.zh: 这对被告来说具有极大的偏见。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有趣。

sentences.en: Meaning that Donald Trump would actually not get a fair trial were those allegations to be mentioned.
sentences.zh: 意思是如果提到这些指控，唐纳德·特朗普实际上无法获得公正的审判。

sentences.en: And so he will not let those in.
sentences.zh: 所以他不会让那些人进去。

sentences.en: The jurors will not hear about them.
sentences.zh: 陪审员们不会听到关于他们的内容。

sentences.en: So this is a setback, of course, for the prosecution, a victory for Trump's legal team.
sentences.zh: 当然，这对控方来说是一个挫折，但对特朗普的法律团队来说是一次胜利。

sentences.en: It's a setback.
sentences.zh: 这是一个挫折。

sentences.en: And it also just shows you how these pretrial motions shape the context of the trial.
sentences.zh: 这也向你展示了这些审前动议是如何塑造审判背景的。

sentences.en: Think of the trial as a venue, like a theater or an athletic contest of some sort.
sentences.zh: 把审判想象成一个场地，就像剧院或某种体育比赛。

sentences.en: And these pretrial motions are about what gets let into the arena and what stays out.
sentences.zh: 而这些审前动议就是关于什么能进入竞技场，什么必须被挡在外面。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The sexual assault allegations, out.
sentences.zh: 性侵指控，排除。

sentences.en: The National Enquirer headlines, in.
sentences.zh: 《国家询问报》的头条，准入。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And how is Trump sitting there at the defense table reacting to these pretrial motion rulings from the judge?
sentences.zh: 那么特朗普坐在辩护席上，对法官这些审前动议的裁决有什么反应？

sentences.en: Well, as I've just said, this is very important stuff for his trial.
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我刚才所说，这对他的审判非常重要。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Hugely important.
sentences.zh: 非常重要。

sentences.en: But it's all happening in legal language.
sentences.zh: 但这一切都是用法律术语进行的。

sentences.en: And I'm decoding it for you.
sentences.zh: 我正在为你解读。

sentences.en: But if you were sitting there listening to it, you might get a little loSt.
sentences.zh: 但如果你坐在那里听，你可能会有点迷糊。

sentences.en: And you might get a little bored.
sentences.zh: 而且你可能会觉得有点无聊。

sentences.en: And Trump, who is not involved in these arguments, seems to fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 而没有参与这些辩论的特朗普，似乎睡着了。

sentences.en: Seems to fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 似乎睡着了。

sentences.en: You're seeing this with your own eyes.
sentences.zh: 你是亲眼目睹了这一切。

sentences.en: What we're seeing overall, including our colleague Maggie Haberman, who's in the overflow room and has a direct view of Trump's face.
sentences.zh: 我们整体观察到的情况，包括我们的同事玛吉·哈伯曼，她坐在溢出房间，能直接看到特朗普的脸。

sentences.en: I'm sitting behind him in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 我就坐在法庭里他的身后。

sentences.en: So I can't see his face that well.
sentences.zh: 所以我看不清他的脸。

sentences.en: You guys are double teaming this.
sentences.zh: 你们俩在打配合。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I'm sitting behind him.
sentences.zh: 我坐在他后面。

sentences.en: But Maggie's sitting in front of him.
sentences.zh: 但玛吉坐在他前面。

sentences.en: And what she sees is not only that his eyes are closed.
sentences.zh: 她看到的不仅是他的眼睛闭上了。

sentences.en: That wouldn't get you to he is asleep.
sentences.zh: 光凭这一点还不能断定他睡着了。

sentences.en: And we have to be really careful about reporting that he's asleep, even if it seems like a frivolous thing.
sentences.zh: 我们必须非常谨慎地报道他睡着了这件事，即使这看起来像是一件琐碎的事。

sentences.en: But what happens is that his head is dropping down to his cheSt.
sentences.zh: 但发生的情况是，他的头垂到了胸前。

sentences.en: And then it's snapping back up.
sentences.zh: 然后又猛地抬起来。

sentences.en: So you've seen that.
sentences.zh: 所以你看到了。

sentences.en: I've done that.
sentences.zh: 我也经历过。

sentences.en: Yeah, we all kind of know that feeling of snapping awake suddenly.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们都知道那种突然惊醒的感觉。

sentences.en: And we see the head motion.
sentences.zh: 我们看到了那个点头的动作。

sentences.en: And it happens several times.
sentences.zh: 而且发生了好几次。

sentences.en: Lawyers kind of bothering him, not quite shaking him, but certainly trying to get his attention.
sentences.zh: 律师们有点在打扰他，虽然没有摇晃他，但肯定是在试图引起他的注意。

sentences.en: And that head snapping motion, we felt confident enough to report that Trump fell asleep.
sentences.zh: 而那个点头的动作，让我们有足够的信心报道特朗普睡着了。

sentences.en: During his own criminal trials opening day.
sentences.zh: 在他自己刑事审判的第一天。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Does someone eventually wake him up?
sentences.zh: 有人最终叫醒他了吗？

sentences.en: He wakes up.
sentences.zh: 他醒了。

sentences.en: He wakes up.
sentences.zh: 他醒了。

sentences.en: And in fact, in the afternoon, he's much more animated.
sentences.zh: 事实上，到了下午，他活跃多了。

sentences.en: It's almost as if he wants to be seen being very much awake.
sentences.zh: 就好像他想让人看到他非常清醒一样。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So once these pretrial motions are ruled on and Trump is, you know, snapped back to attention, what happens?
sentences.zh: 那么，一旦这些审前动议有了裁决，而特朗普，你知道，回过神来了，接下来会发生什么？

sentences.en: Well, what happens in the courtroom is that the trial begins.
sentences.zh: 嗯，法庭里发生的事情是审判开始了。

sentences.en: The first trial of an American president is now in session.
sentences.zh: 美国总统的首次审判现在开庭了。

sentences.en: And what marks that beginning is jurors walking into the room one by one, many of them kind of craning their necks over at Donald Trump, giggling,
sentences.zh: 标志着这一开始的是陪审员们一个接一个地走进房间，他们中的许多人伸长脖子看向唐纳德·特朗普，咯咯地笑，

sentences.en: raising their eyebrows at each other, filing into the room and being sworn in by the judge.
sentences.zh: 互相挑眉，排队走进房间并由法官宣誓就职。

sentences.en: And that swearing in marks the official beginning of the trial.
sentences.zh: 而那个宣誓标志着审判的正式开始。

sentences.en: The beginning is jury selection.
sentences.zh: 开始是陪审团遴选。

sentences.en: And it's often overlooked.
sentences.zh: 这经常被忽视。

sentences.en: It's not dramatized in our kind of courtroom dramas in the same way.
sentences.zh: 它在我们的法庭剧中并没有以同样的方式被戏剧化。

sentences.en: But it's so important.
sentences.zh: 但它非常重要。

sentences.en: It's one of the most important parts of the case.
sentences.zh: 这是案件最重要的部分之一。

sentences.en: Because whoever sits on the jury, these are the 12 people who are going to decide whether Trump is guilty or whether Trump is innocent.
sentences.zh: 因为无论谁坐在陪审团里，这12个人都将决定特朗普是有罪还是无罪。

sentences.en: So how does jury selection actually look and feel and go?
sentences.zh: 那么陪审团遴选实际上看起来、感觉起来和进行起来是什么样的？

sentences.en: So jury selection is a winnowing process.
sentences.zh: 陪审团遴选是一个筛选过程。

sentences.en: And in order to do that, you have to have these people go through a bunch of different hurdles.
sentences.zh: 为了做到这一点，你必须让这些人经历一系列不同的障碍。

sentences.en: So the first hurdle is after the judge describes the case, he asks the group, and there are just short of 100 of them, whether they can be fair and impartial,
sentences.zh: 所以第一个障碍是，在法官描述案情后，他会问这群人——他们有将近100人——他们是否能做到公平公正，

sentences.en: and says that if they can't, they should leave.
sentences.zh: 并说如果不能，他们就应该离开。

sentences.en: And more than half the group is instantly gone.
sentences.zh: 超过一半的人立刻就走了。

sentences.en: Whoa.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So after we do this kind of big mass excusal, we're left with a smaller group.
sentences.zh: 所以在我们进行了这种大规模的免除之后，我们剩下了一小群人。

sentences.en: And so now jurors are getting called in smaller groups to the jury box.
sentences.zh: 现在陪审员们正被分成小组叫到陪审席上。

sentences.en: And what they're going to do there is they're going to answer this questionnaire.
sentences.zh: 他们要在那里做的是回答这份问卷。

sentences.en: And this part of the process is really conducted by the judge.
sentences.zh: 而这个过程的这一部分实际上是由法官主持的。

sentences.en: The lawyers are involved.
sentences.zh: 律师们也参与其中。

sentences.en: They're listening.
sentences.zh: 他们在听。

sentences.en: But they're not yet asking questions of the jurors themselves.
sentences.zh: 但他们还没有亲自向陪审员提问。

sentences.en: And what's on the questionnaire?
sentences.zh: 问卷上有什么？

sentences.en: Well, it's 42 questions.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有42个问题。

sentences.en: And the questions include their education, their professional histories, their hobbies, what they like to do, whether you're a member of QAnon or Antifa.
sentences.zh: 问题包括他们的教育背景、职业经历、爱好、他们喜欢做什么，以及你是否是“匿名者Q”或“反法西斯主义运动”的成员。

sentences.en: Whether you're far left or far right.
sentences.zh: 你是极左还是极右。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Whether you've read The Art of the Deal, Trump's book, which some prospective jurors had.
sentences.zh: 你是否读过特朗普的书《交易的艺术》，一些潜在的陪审员读过。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It was a bestseller in its time.
sentences.zh: 它在当时是一本畅销书。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And some of it can be answered in yes, no questions.
sentences.zh: 其中一些可以用“是”或“否”来回答。

sentences.en: But some of it can be answered more at length.
sentences.zh: 但有些可以回答得更详细。

sentences.en: So some of the prospective jurors are going very, very faSt.
sentences.zh: 所以一些潜在的陪审员回答得非常非常快。

sentences.en: Yes, no, no, no, yes.
sentences.zh: 是，否，否，否，是。

sentences.en: Right, because this is an oral questionnaire.
sentences.zh: 没错，因为这是一个口头问卷。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: But some of them are taking their time.
sentences.zh: 但有些人花了不少时间。

sentences.en: They're expanding on their hobbies.
sentences.zh: 他们在扩展谈论自己的爱好。

sentences.en: So the potential juror in seat three, for example, is talking about her hobbies.
sentences.zh: 例如，坐在3号位置的潜在陪审员正在谈论她的爱好。

sentences.en: And she says some, you know, running, hiking.
sentences.zh: 她说了一些，你知道，跑步，徒步旅行。

sentences.en: And then she said, I like to go to the club.
sentences.zh: 然后她说，我喜欢去夜店。

sentences.en: And it got a huge laugh.
sentences.zh: 这引起了一阵大笑。

sentences.en: And you get that kind of thing in jury selection, which is one of the reasons it's so fun.
sentences.zh: 你在陪审团遴选中会遇到这种情况，这也是它如此有趣的原因之一。

sentences.en: It's the height of normality in this situation that is anything but normal.
sentences.zh: 这是在这种一点也不正常的情况下，最正常不过的时刻了。

sentences.en: The most banal answer possible delivered in front of the former president and current Republican nominee for president.
sentences.zh: 在一位前总统和现任共和党总统候选人面前，给出了最平庸的回答。

sentences.en: Well, that's one of the fascinating parts about all this, right, is that they're answering in front of Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这就是这一切引人入胜的部分之一，对吧，他们是在特朗普面前回答问题。

sentences.en: And they're answering questions about Trump in front of Trump.
sentences.zh: 而且他们是在特朗普面前回答关于特朗普的问题。

sentences.en: He doesn't react all that much.
sentences.zh: 他并没有太大的反应。

sentences.en: But whenever someone says they've read The Art of the Deal, and there are a few of those, he kind of nods appreciatively, smiles.
sentences.zh: 但每当有人说他们读过《交易的艺术》时——确实有几个人读过——他就会赞赏地点点头，微笑。

sentences.en: He likes that.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢那样。

sentences.en: It's very clear.
sentences.zh: 这很明显。

sentences.en: But because there are so many questions, this is taking forever.
sentences.zh: 但因为问题太多，这花的时间太长了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Especially when people are choosing to answer and elaborate and digress.
sentences.zh: 特别是当人们选择回答、详细阐述和离题时。

sentences.en: This is when you fall asleep.
sentences.zh: 这就是你会睡着的时候。

sentences.en: This is when I would have fallen asleep if I were a normal person.
sentences.zh: 如果我是个普通人，我也会在那个时候睡着。

sentences.en: And by the end of the day, where does jury selection stand?
sentences.zh: 到了一天结束时，陪审团遴选进展如何？

sentences.en: Well, the questionnaire is another device for shrinking that jury pool.
sentences.zh: 嗯，问卷是缩小陪审团候选人范围的另一种手段。

sentences.en: And so the questionnaire has almost these little obstacles or roadblocks, including, in fact, a question that jurors have seen before,
sentences.zh: 所以问卷几乎有这些小障碍或路障，事实上包括一个陪审员之前见过的问题，

sentences.en: whether they would have any problem being fair and impartial.
sentences.zh: 他们是否有任何问题无法做到公平公正。

sentences.en: And they ask it again.
sentences.zh: 他们又问了一遍。

sentences.en: They're asked it again.
sentences.zh: 他们又被问了一遍。

sentences.en: And they're asked it in this more individualized way.
sentences.zh: 而且他们是以这种更个性化的方式被问到的。

sentences.en: The judge is questioning them.
sentences.zh: 法官在质询他们。

sentences.en: They're responding.
sentences.zh: 他们在回应。

sentences.en: So remember that woman who said she liked to go to the club?
sentences.zh: 还记得那个说她喜欢去夜店的女士吗？

sentences.en: Got a big laugh.
sentences.zh: 引起了一阵大笑。

sentences.en: She reaches question 34.
sentences.zh: 她回答到了第34题。

sentences.en: And question 34 reads,
sentences.zh: 第34题写着，

sentences.en: Do you have any strong opinions or firmly held beliefs about former President Donald Trump or the fact that he is a current candidate for president that would interfere with your ability to be a fair and impartial juror?
sentences.zh: 你对前总统唐纳德·特朗普或他是现任总统候选人这一事实是否有任何强烈的观点或坚定的信念，从而会干扰你作为公平公正的陪审员的能力？

sentences.en: She said yes.
sentences.zh: 她说有。

sentences.en: She does have an opinion that would prevent her from being fair and impartial.
sentences.zh: 她确实有一个会阻止她做到公平公正的观点。

sentences.en: And she, too, is excused.
sentences.zh: 于是她也被免除了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So that's how it works.
sentences.zh: 这就是它的运作方式。

sentences.en: People answer the questionnaire and they get excused in that way or they have a scheduling conflict once they reach the jury box.
sentences.zh: 人们回答问卷，然后以那种方式被免除，或者一旦他们坐到陪审席上，就会遇到日程冲突。

sentences.en: And so to answer your question, Michael, at the end of day one,
sentences.zh: 所以回答你的问题，迈克尔，在第一天结束时，

sentences.en: given all these problems with the questionnaire and the length of time it's taking to respond to and people getting dismissed based on their answers,
sentences.zh: 考虑到问卷的所有这些问题、回答所需的时间长度以及人们根据回答被解雇的情况，

sentences.en: there is not a single juror seated for this trial.
sentences.zh: 这次审判还没有选定一名陪审员。

sentences.en: And it's starting to look like this is going to be a really hard case for which to find an impartial jury.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来这对于寻找一个公正的陪审团来说将是一个非常困难的案件。

sentences.en: That's the feeling in the room.
sentences.zh: 这就是房间里的感觉。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynne Lowe.
sentences.zh: 我是温·洛。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games.
sentences.zh: 我编写《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖尔斯基。

sentences.en: And I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我每天制作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: So, Donald, let's turn to day two.
sentences.zh: 那么，唐纳德，让我们转到第二天。

sentences.en: What does jury selection look like on Tuesday?
sentences.zh: 周二的陪审团遴选是什么样的？

sentences.en: So, when the day begins, it looks almost exactly like it looked when the day ended on Monday.
sentences.zh: 所以，当新的一天开始时，它看起来和周一结束时几乎一模一样。

sentences.en: We're still with the questionnaire, getting some interesting answers.
sentences.zh: 我们还在进行问卷调查，得到了一些有趣的回答。

sentences.en: But even though it feels like we're going slow, we are going.
sentences.zh: 尽管感觉进展缓慢，但我们确实在推进。

sentences.en: And so, we've gone from about 100 people to now there's about 24 in the room.
sentences.zh: 就这样，我们从大约100人减少到了现在房间里的24人左右。

sentences.en: There's 18 in the jury box.
sentences.zh: 陪审团席位上有18人。

sentences.en: And by the time we hit lunch, all those people have answered all those questions.
sentences.zh: 到午餐时间，这些人已经回答了所有问题。

sentences.en: And we are ready for the next step in the process.
sentences.zh: 我们准备好进入流程的下一个阶段了。

sentences.en: Which is?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Voidier.
sentences.zh: 陪审员遴选（Voir Dire）。

sentences.en: And what it is, is the heart of jury selection.
sentences.zh: 这就是陪审员遴选的核心。

sentences.en: This is the point where the lawyers themselves finally get to interview the jurors.
sentences.zh: 这是律师们终于可以亲自面试陪审员的环节。

sentences.en: And we get so much information from this moment.
sentences.zh: 我们从这一刻获得了大量信息。

sentences.en: Because the lawyers ask questions based on what they want out of the jurors.
sentences.zh: 因为律师会根据他们对陪审员的期望来提出问题。

sentences.en: So, the prosecution is asking all these different kinds of questions.
sentences.zh: 所以，检方提出了各种各样的问题。

sentences.en: The first round of Voidier is done by a guy named Joshua Steinglass, very experienced trial lawyer with the Manhattan District Attorney's Office.
sentences.zh: 第一轮陪审员遴选由曼哈顿地区检察官办公室一位经验非常丰富的出庭律师乔舒亚·斯坦格拉斯（Joshua Steinglass）负责。

sentences.en: And he's providing all these hypotheticals.
sentences.zh: 他提出了各种假设性问题。

sentences.en: I'll give you one example because I found this one really, really interesting.
sentences.zh: 我举个例子，因为我觉得这个特别特别有意思。

sentences.en: He provides a hypothetical about a man who wants his wife killed and essentially hires a hitman to do it.
sentences.zh: 他提出了一个假设：一个人想杀掉他的妻子，于是雇佣了一名杀手去执行。

sentences.en: And what he asked the jurors is, if that case were before you, would you be able to see that the man who hired the hitman was a part of this crime?
sentences.zh: 他问陪审员的是，如果这个案子由你们审理，你们能看出雇佣杀手的那个人也是这起罪行的一部分吗？

sentences.en: And of course, what he's really getting at is, can you accept that even though Michael Cohen, Trump's fixer, made this payment, Trump is the guy who hired him to do it?
sentences.zh: 当然，他真正想表达的是：你们能否接受，尽管是特朗普的“清理人”迈克尔·科恩（Michael Cohen）支付了这笔钱，但特朗普才是雇佣他做这件事的人？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: If there are other people involved, will jurors still be able to see Donald Trump's hands behind it all?
sentences.zh: 如果还有其他人参与，陪审员是否仍能看出这一切背后的操盘手是唐纳德·特朗普？

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: And what were some of the responses?
sentences.zh: 那么有哪些回应呢？

sentences.en: People mostly said, yes, we accept that.
sentences.zh: 人们大多说，是的，我们接受这一点。

sentences.en: So, that's how the prosecution did it.
sentences.zh: 这就是检方采取的方式。

sentences.en: But the defense had a totally different method of Voidier.
sentences.zh: 但辩方采取了完全不同的陪审员遴选方法。

sentences.en: They were very focused on their client and people's opinions about their client.
sentences.zh: 他们非常关注他们的当事人，以及人们对他们当事人的看法。

sentences.en: So, what kind of questions do we get from them?
sentences.zh: 那么，他们会提出什么样的问题呢？

sentences.en: So, the lawyer, Todd Blanche, is asking people, what do you make of President Trump?
sentences.zh: 律师托德·布兰奇（Todd Blanche）问人们：你们怎么看特朗普总统？

sentences.en: What do you think of President Trump?
sentences.zh: 你们对特朗普总统有什么看法？

sentences.en: And what are some of the responses to that?
sentences.zh: 对此有哪些回应？

sentences.en: Well, there's this incredible exchange with one of the jurors who absolutely refuses to give his opinion of Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 嗯，其中一位陪审员与他进行了一场不可思议的交锋，这位陪审员坚决拒绝给出他对唐纳德·特朗普的看法。

sentences.en: They go back and forth and back and forth and the juror keeps insisting, you don't need to know my opinion of him.
sentences.zh: 他们来回拉锯，而这位陪审员一直坚持说：你不需要知道我对他的看法。

sentences.en: All you need to know is that I'm going to be fair and impartial, like I said.
sentences.zh: 你只需要知道，正如我所说，我会做到公平公正。

sentences.en: And Blanche pushes and the guy pushes back.
sentences.zh: 布兰奇步步紧逼，那个人也毫不退让。

sentences.en: And the only way the guy budges is he finally kind of confesses almost at the end that, yes, I am a Democrat.
sentences.zh: 那个人唯一松口的地方，是在最后几乎承认了：是的，我是民主党人。

sentences.en: And that's all we get.
sentences.zh: 我们得到的就只有这些。

sentences.en: And what ends up happening to this potential juror?
sentences.zh: 那么这位潜在陪审员最终怎么样了？

sentences.en: Believe it or not, he got dismissed.
sentences.zh: 信不信由你，他被解职了。

sentences.en: I can believe it.
sentences.zh: 我信。

sentences.en: And of course, it's worth saying that this guy and everybody else is being asked that question just feet from Trump himself.
sentences.zh: 当然，值得一提的是，这个人和其他所有人被问到这个问题时，距离特朗普本人只有几英尺远。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And you might think you were going to get a really kind of spicy, like popcorn emoji type exchange from that.
sentences.zh: 你可能以为会从中看到一场非常火爆、像爆米花表情包那样的交锋。

sentences.en: But because these are now jurors who have said they can be fair and impartial, who to some extent want to be on this jury or at least wouldn't mind being on this jury,
sentences.zh: 但因为这些人现在都是已经表示可以做到公平公正的陪审员，而且在某种程度上他们想加入这个陪审团，或者至少不介意加入，

sentences.en: they're being very restrained.
sentences.zh: 他们表现得非常克制。

sentences.en: And mostly what they are emphasizing, much like that guy I just described did, is that they can be fair.
sentences.zh: 他们主要强调的，就像我刚才描述的那个人一样，是他们能够做到公平。

sentences.en: They can be impartial.
sentences.zh: 他们能够做到公正。

sentences.en: There's one woman who gives this really remarkable answer.
sentences.zh: 有一位女士给出了一个非常了不起的回答。

sentences.en: She says, you know, I thought about this last night.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，我昨晚想了这个问题。

sentences.en: I stayed up all night.
sentences.zh: 我彻夜未眠。

sentences.en: I couldn't sleep, thinking about whether I could be fair.
sentences.zh: 我睡不着，一直在想我是否能做到公平。

sentences.en: It's really important to me.
sentences.zh: 这对我来说真的很重要。

sentences.en: And I can.
sentences.zh: 而我能做到。

sentences.en: What ends up happening to that particular juror?
sentences.zh: 那位特定的陪审员最终怎么样了？

sentences.en: She's also dismissed.
sentences.zh: 她也被解职了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And she's dismissed without any reason at all.
sentences.zh: 而且她被解职时没有任何理由。

sentences.en: The defense decides it doesn't like her, doesn't want her on the jury.
sentences.zh: 辩方决定不喜欢她，不想让她进入陪审团。

sentences.en: And they have a certain number of chances to just get rid of jurors, no questions asked.
sentences.zh: 他们有一定次数的机会可以直接剔除陪审员，无需任何理由。

sentences.en: Other jurors are getting dismissed for cause.
sentences.zh: 其他陪审员则是因为“有正当理由”被解职。

sentences.en: I'm doing air quotes with my hands, which means that the lawyers have argued.
sentences.zh: 我用手比划了引号，这意味着律师们已经进行了辩论。

sentences.en: They've actually revealed themselves through their answers or through old social media posts, which are brought up in the courtroom, to be either non-credible,
sentences.zh: 他们实际上通过回答或法庭上提出的旧社交媒体帖子，暴露了自己要么不可信，

sentences.en: meaning they've said they can be fair and they can't, or somehow too biased to be on the jury.
sentences.zh: 意思是他们说自己能做到公平但实际上做不到，要么就是偏见太深，不适合留在陪审团。

sentences.en: Wait, can I just dial into that for a second?
sentences.zh: 等等，我能插一句吗？

sentences.en: Second, are lawyers researching the jurors in real time, going online and saying, I'm making this up, but Jonah Bromwich is a potential juror,
sentences.zh: 律师们是在实时调查陪审员吗？上网搜索，比如——我这是编的——乔纳·布罗姆维奇（Jonah Bromwich）是潜在陪审员，

sentences.en: and I'm going to go off into my little corner of the courtroom and Google everything you've ever said?
sentences.zh: 然后我走到法庭的一个小角落，把你曾经说过的一切都谷歌一遍？

sentences.en: Is that what's happening in the room?
sentences.zh: 房间里发生的是这种情况吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, there's a whole profession dedicated to that.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一个专门从事这项工作的职业。

sentences.en: It's called jury consultant, and they're very good at finding information on people in a hurry, and it certainly looked as if they were in play.
sentences.zh: 这叫陪审团顾问，他们非常擅长快速查找人们的信息，而且看起来他们确实参与其中。

sentences.en: Did a social media post end up getting anybody kicked off this jury?
sentences.zh: 社交媒体帖子最终导致有人被踢出陪审团了吗？

sentences.en: Yes, there were posts from kind of 2016-era internet.
sentences.zh: 是的，有一些来自2016年左右互联网时代的帖子。

sentences.en: You'll remember that time as a very heated one on the internet.
sentences.zh: 你会记得那个时期互联网上非常激烈。

sentences.en: Facebook memes are a big thing, and so there's all kinds of lock-him-up type memes and rhetoric, and some of the potential jurors here have used those,
sentences.zh: Facebook表情包当时很流行，所以有各种各样的“把他关起来”之类的表情包和言论，这里的一些潜在陪审员使用过这些，

sentences.en: and those jurors are dismissed for a reason.
sentences.zh: 而这些陪审员就被以正当理由解职了。

sentences.en: Fascinating.
sentences.zh: 太迷人了。

sentences.en: So we have these two types of dismissals, right?
sentences.zh: 所以我们有两种解职方式，对吧？

sentences.en: We have these peremptory dismissals, no reason at all given, and we have four-cause dismissals.
sentences.zh: 一种是无须理由的强制解职，另一种是有正当理由的解职。

sentences.en: And the process is called jury selection, but you don't actually get selected for a jury.
sentences.zh: 这个过程叫陪审员遴选，但你实际上并不是被“选中”进入陪审团的。

sentences.en: The thing is to make it through all these obstacles.
sentences.zh: 关键是要闯过所有这些障碍。

sentences.en: You're kind of, you're left over.
sentences.zh: 你算是……剩下的那部分人。

sentences.en: Right, and so when certain jurors are not dismissed and they've made it through all these stages, by the end of the day,
sentences.zh: 没错，所以当某些陪审员没有被解职，并且通过了所有这些阶段，到了一天结束时，

sentences.en: we've gone from zero jurors seated to seven jurors who will be participating in Donald Trump's trial.
sentences.zh: 我们已经从零名陪审员增加到了七名将参与唐纳德·特朗普审判的陪审员。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And without going through all seven, just give us a little bit of a sketch of who so far is on this jury.
sentences.zh: 不用一一介绍这七个人，给我们简单勾勒一下目前陪审团里都有谁。

sentences.en: What stands out?
sentences.zh: 有什么突出的特点吗？

sentences.en: Well, not that much stands out.
sentences.zh: 嗯，没什么特别突出的。

sentences.en: So we've got four men.
sentences.zh: 我们有四名男性。

sentences.en: We've got three women.
sentences.zh: 我们有三名女性。

sentences.en: You know, one lives on the Upper East Side.
sentences.zh: 你知道，有一个住在上东区。

sentences.en: One lives in Chelsea.
sentences.zh: 有一个住在切尔西区。

sentences.en: Obviously, they're from all over Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 显然，他们来自曼哈顿各地。

sentences.en: They have these kind of very normal hobbies, like spending time with family and friends.
sentences.zh: 他们有一些非常普通的爱好，比如花时间和家人朋友在一起。

sentences.en: They have somewhat anonymous jobs.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作也相对普通。

sentences.en: We've got two lawyers.
sentences.zh: 我们有两名律师。

sentences.en: We've got someone who's worked in sales.
sentences.zh: 我们有一位从事销售工作的人。

sentences.en: So there's not that much identifying information, and that's not an accident.
sentences.zh: 所以没有太多能识别身份的信息，这并非偶然。

sentences.en: One of the things that often happens with jury selection, whether it be for Donald Trump or for anyone else, is the most interesting jurors,
sentences.zh: 陪审员遴选过程中经常发生的一件事，无论是针对唐纳德·特朗普还是其他人，就是那些最有趣的陪审员，

sentences.en: the jurors that kind of catch your attention during the process,
sentences.zh: 那些在过程中吸引你注意力的陪审员，

sentences.en: they get picked off because they are being so interesting that they interest one or the other side in a negative way, and soon they're excused.
sentences.zh: 他们会被剔除，因为他们表现得太有趣，以至于引起了某一方的负面关注，很快他们就被免职了。

sentences.en: So most of the jurors who are actually seated are not memorable, are not that memorable.
sentences.zh: 所以大多数最终入选的陪审员都不太令人印象深刻，没那么显眼。

sentences.en: Save one particular juror.
sentences.zh: 除了一位特殊的陪审员。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I'll bite.
sentences.zh: 我上钩了。

sentences.en: What do I need to know about that one particular juror?
sentences.zh: 关于那位特殊的陪审员，我需要知道什么？

sentences.en: So let me tell you about a prospective juror who we knew as 374 who will now be juror number five.
sentences.zh: 让我告诉你一位我们称之为374号的准陪审员，她现在将成为5号陪审员。

sentences.en: She's a middle school teacher from Harlem, and she said that she has friends who have really strong opinions about Trump.
sentences.zh: 她是一位来自哈莱姆区的中学老师，她说她有朋友对特朗普有非常强烈的看法。

sentences.en: But she herself does not, and she insisted several times, I am not a political person.
sentences.zh: 但她自己没有，她多次坚持说：我不是一个政治化的人。

sentences.en: And then she said this thing that made me quite surprised that the prosecution was fine with having her on the jury.
sentences.zh: 然后她说了一件事，让我非常惊讶检方竟然同意让她进入陪审团。

sentences.en: She said, quote, President Trump speaks his mind, and I'd rather that than someone who's in office who you don't know what they're thinking.
sentences.zh: 她说，引用原话：“特朗普总统直言不讳，我宁愿要这样的人，也不愿要那种你根本不知道他在想什么的在职官员。”

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: So she expressed approval of President Trump.
sentences.zh: 所以她表达了对特朗普总统的赞同。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was mild approval.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是温和的赞同。

sentences.en: But the thing is, especially for the defense in this trial, all you need is one juror.
sentences.zh: 但问题是，特别是在这次审判的辩方看来，你只需要一名陪审员就够了。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: One juror can tie up deliberations and knots, and you can end with a hung jury.
sentences.zh: 一名陪审员就能让审议陷入僵局，最终导致流审。

sentences.en: And this is actually something that I saw firsthand.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是我亲眼所见的事情。

sentences.en: In 2019, I was the foreperson on a jury.
sentences.zh: 2019年，我曾担任陪审团的领头人。

sentences.en: How do you like that?
sentences.zh: 你觉得怎么样？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the trial was really complicated.
sentences.zh: 那场审判非常复杂。

sentences.en: But I had thought while we were doing the trial, oh, this is going to be a really easy decision.
sentences.zh: 但在审判过程中，我曾想：哦，这会是一个非常容易做出的决定。

sentences.en: I thought the defendant in that case was guilty.
sentences.zh: 我当时认为那个案子的被告是有罪的。

sentences.en: So we get into deliberations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们进入了审议阶段。

sentences.en: But there's this one juror who keeps gumming up the works.
sentences.zh: 但有一名陪审员一直在搅局。

sentences.en: Every time we seem to be making progress, getting a conversation started, this juror proverbially throws up his hands and says, I am not convicting.
sentences.zh: 每当我们似乎取得进展，开始对话时，这位陪审员就会习惯性地摊开双手说：我不会定罪。

sentences.en: This man is innocent.
sentences.zh: 这个人是无辜的。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: And we talked and we talked.
sentences.zh: 我们谈了又谈。

sentences.en: And as the foreperson, I was trying to use all my skills to mediate.
sentences.zh: 作为领头人，我试图运用我所有的技巧进行调解。

sentences.en: But any time we made any progress, this guy would blow it up.
sentences.zh: 但每当我们取得一点进展，这家伙就会把它搞砸。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And long story short, hung jury, big victory for the defense lawyer.
sentences.zh: 长话短说，流审了，这对辩护律师来说是一场大胜利。

sentences.en: And we come out of the room, and she points at this juror, the guy who—
sentences.zh: 我们走出房间，她指着这位陪审员，那个——

sentences.en: The defense lawyer.
sentences.zh: 辩护律师。

sentences.en: The defense lawyer points at this juror who blew everything up, and she said, I knew it.
sentences.zh: 辩护律师指着那个把一切都搞砸的陪审员说：我就知道。

sentences.en: I knew I had my guy.
sentences.zh: 我就知道我选对人了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I don't want to read too much into what you said about that one juror, but should I read between the lines to think that if there's a hung jury,
sentences.zh: 我不想过度解读你关于那位陪审员的话，但我是否应该从字里行间理解为，如果出现流审，

sentences.en: you wonder if it might be that juror?
sentences.zh: 你怀疑可能是那个陪审员造成的？

sentences.en: That's what everyone in the courtroom is wondering, not just about this juror, but about every single person who was selected.
sentences.zh: 法庭上的每个人都在怀疑这一点，不仅是关于这位陪审员，而是关于每一位被选中的人。

sentences.en: Hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯。

sentences.en: Is this the person who swings the case for me?
sentences.zh: 这是那个能让案子向我有利方向倾斜的人吗？

sentences.en: Is this the person who swings the case against me?
sentences.zh: 这是那个能让案子向我不利方向倾斜的人吗？

sentences.en: These juries are so complex.
sentences.zh: 这些陪审团太复杂了。

sentences.en: It's 12 people who don't know each other at the start of the trial, and by the end of the trial have seen each other every morning and are experiencing the same things,
sentences.zh: 这是12个在审判开始时互不相识的人，到审判结束时，他们每天早上都见面，经历着同样的事情，

sentences.en: but are not allowed to have talked about the case until deliberations start.
sentences.zh: 但在审议开始前，他们是不允许讨论案情的。

sentences.en: In that moment, when deliberations start—
sentences.zh: 在那一刻，当审议开始时——

sentences.en: You're going to learn a whole lot about each other.
sentences.zh: 你会非常了解彼此。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There's this alchemical moment where suddenly it all matters.
sentences.zh: 会出现那种炼金术般的时刻，突然间一切都变得至关重要。

sentences.en: Every personality selected matters, and that's why jury selection is so important, and that's why these last two days are actually one of the most important parts of this trial.
sentences.zh: 选出的每一位陪审员都很重要，这就是为什么陪审团遴选如此关键，也是为什么过去这两天实际上是这场审判中最重要的部分之一。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So by my math, this trial will require five more jurors to get to 12.
sentences.zh: 按照我的计算，这场审判还需要五名陪审员才能凑齐12人。

sentences.en: I know also they're going to need to be alternates.
sentences.zh: 我也知道他们还需要候补陪审员。

sentences.en: But from what you're saying,
sentences.zh: 但从你所说的来看，

sentences.en: what looked like a really uphill battle to get an impartial jury or a jury that said it could be impartial and Trump was very doubtful one could be found has turned out to not be so hard to find.
sentences.zh: 原本看起来是一场极其艰难的硬仗，即寻找一个公正的陪审团，或者说一个声称自己能保持公正的陪审团——特朗普曾非常怀疑能否找到这样的人——结果发现其实并不难。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So they've said, no, that's not the key issue here.
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，不，那不是这里的关键问题。

sentences.en: The key issue is not whether or not people have opinions about Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 关键问题不在于人们对唐纳德·特朗普是否有看法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Who doesn't have an opinion about Donald Trump?
sentences.zh: 谁对唐纳德·特朗普没有看法呢？

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: They're going to.
sentences.zh: 他们肯定会有。

sentences.en: Automatically, they're going to.
sentences.zh: 自然而然地，他们会有。

sentences.en: The question is whether or not they can be fair and impartial.
sentences.zh: 问题在于他们能否做到公平公正。

sentences.en: And the seven people we already have seated and presumably the five people that we're going to get over the next few days and however many alternates we expect six are all going to have answered that question.
sentences.zh: 我们已经选出的七个人，以及推测我们未来几天将选出的五个人，还有我们预期的六名候补陪审员，他们都将回答这个问题。

sentences.en: Not I hate Trump.
sentences.zh: 不是说我讨厌特朗普。

sentences.en: I love Trump.
sentences.zh: 我热爱特朗普。

sentences.en: But I can weigh in on the former president's innocence or guilt, and I can do it as fairly as humanly possible.
sentences.zh: 而是说我能否权衡这位前总统是否有罪，并且尽可能公平地做出判断。

sentences.en: Now, Trump is not happy about this.
sentences.zh: 现在，特朗普对此并不高兴。

sentences.en: He said after court yesterday, quote, we have a highly conflicted judge and he's rushing this trial.
sentences.zh: 他昨天庭审后说，引用他的话，“我们遇到了一位极具偏见的法官，他正在仓促推进这场审判”。

sentences.en: And I think that he is going to see these beats of the system, the criminal justice system, as it works on him, as he is experiencing it as unfair.
sentences.zh: 我认为他会把刑事司法系统在他身上运作的这些节奏，以及他所经历的一切，视为不公。

sentences.en: That is typically how he talks about it and how he views it.
sentences.zh: 这通常就是他谈论和看待这件事的方式。

sentences.en: But what he's getting is what defendants get.
sentences.zh: 但他所经历的正是被告人通常会经历的。

sentences.en: This is the system in New York, in the United States.
sentences.zh: 这就是纽约、这就是美国的制度。

sentences.en: This is its answer to how do you pick a fair jury?
sentences.zh: 这就是它对于“如何挑选一个公平的陪审团”这一问题的回答。

sentences.en: Well, you ask people, can you be fair?
sentences.zh: 嗯，你问人们，你能做到公平吗？

sentences.en: And you put them through this process and the outcome is 12 people.
sentences.zh: 然后你让他们经历这个过程，最终的结果就是12个人。

sentences.en: And so I think we're going to see this over and over again in this trial.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为在这场审判中，我们会一次又一次地看到这种情况。

sentences.en: We're going to see Trump experience the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 我们将看到特朗普体验刑事司法系统。

sentences.en: And its routines.
sentences.zh: 以及它的常规流程。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Openings, witnesses, evidence, closings.
sentences.zh: 开庭陈述、证人、证据、结案陈词。

sentences.en: He's going to go through all of it.
sentences.zh: 他将经历这一切。

sentences.en: And I think at every turn, it makes sense to expect him to say, well, this is not fair.
sentences.zh: 我认为在每一个环节，他都会说，嗯，这不公平，这是可以预见的。

sentences.en: Well, the judge is doing something wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，法官做错了什么。

sentences.en: Well, the prosecutors are doing something wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，检察官做错了什么。

sentences.en: Well, the jury is doing something wrong.
sentences.zh: 嗯，陪审团做错了什么。

sentences.en: But at the end of the day, he's going to be a defendant and he's going to sit mostly silently if his lawyers can make him do that and watch this process play itself out.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，他将是一名被告，如果他的律师能让他做到的话，他大部分时间会保持沉默，看着这个过程自行展开。

sentences.en: So the system is going to try and treat him like any other defendant, even though, of course, he's not.
sentences.zh: 所以这个系统会试图像对待任何其他被告一样对待他，尽管他当然不是普通人。

sentences.en: He's not.
sentences.zh: 他不是。

sentences.en: And he is going to fight back like no other defendant would, like no other defendant could.
sentences.zh: 而且他会进行反击，这是其他任何被告都不会做、也做不到的。

sentences.en: And that tension, him pushing against the criminal justice system as it strives to treat him as it would anyone else, is going to be a defining quality of this trial.
sentences.zh: 这种张力，即他在刑事司法系统努力像对待其他人一样对待他时所进行的抗争，将成为这场审判的一个决定性特征。

sentences.en: Well, Jonah, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，乔纳，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: P.S.
sentences.zh: 附言。

sentences.en: Have you ever fallen asleep in the trial?
sentences.zh: 你在审判中睡着过吗？

sentences.en: Well, I have not.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我没有。

sentences.en: I figured.
sentences.zh: 我就猜到了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: During a visit to Jerusalem on Wednesday, Britain's foreign secretary left little doubt that Israel would retaliate against Iran for last weekend's aerial attack,
sentences.zh: 周三在访问耶路撒冷期间，英国外交大臣明确表示，以色列将对伊朗上周末的空袭进行报复，

sentences.en: despite pressure from the United States and Britain to stand down.
sentences.zh: 尽管美国和英国施压要求其克制。

sentences.en: The question now is what form that retaliation will take.
sentences.zh: 现在的问题是这种报复将采取何种形式。

sentences.en: The Times reports that Israel is weighing several options, including a direct strike on Iran, a cyber attack, or targeted assassinations.
sentences.zh: 《泰晤士报》报道称，以色列正在权衡多种选择，包括直接打击伊朗、网络攻击或定点清除。

sentences.en: And.
sentences.zh: 而且。

sentences.en: Look, history judges us for what we do.
sentences.zh: 听着，历史会根据我们的所作所为来评判我们。

sentences.en: This is a critical time right now, a critical time on the world stage.
sentences.zh: 现在是一个关键时刻，世界舞台上的关键时刻。

sentences.en: In a plan that could threaten his job, Republican House Speaker Mike Johnson will put a series of foreign aid bills up for a vote this weekend.
sentences.zh: 在一项可能威胁到他职位的计划中，共和党众议院议长迈克·约翰逊将在本周末就一系列对外援助法案进行投票。

sentences.en: The bills, especially for aid to Ukraine, are strongly opposed by far-right House Republicans, at least two of whom have threatened to try to oust Johnson over the plan.
sentences.zh: 这些法案，特别是对乌克兰的援助，遭到了极右翼众议院共和党人的强烈反对，其中至少有两人威胁要因此罢免约翰逊。

sentences.en: You know, I can make a selfish decision and do something that's different, but I'm doing here what I believe to be the right thing.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我可以做出自私的决定，做一些不同的事情，但我在这里做的是我认为正确的事情。

sentences.en: I think providing lethal aid to Ukraine right now is critically important.
sentences.zh: 我认为现在向乌克兰提供致命性援助至关重要。
